mapper.sql: FROM ${studentProfilesDatabase}.student_info si LEFT JOIN sys_student_match m ON m.student_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = si.student_id
LEFT JOIN ${studentProfilesDatabase}.student_info si ON si.student_id = m.student_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci

select m.id, m.user_id, COALESCE(m.match_status, '0') as match_status, m.create_time, m.update_time, si.student_id, si.in_school, si.school_year, si.student_profile_number, si.adid, si.class_section, si.class_num, si.id_name, si.dsej_student_id

select m.id, m.user_id, m.match_status, m.create_time, m.update_time, si.student_id, si.in_school, si.school_year, si.student_profile_number, si.adid, si.class_section, si.class_num, si.id_name, si.dsej_student_id from sys_student_match m
mapper.select:
si.student_id IS NOT NULL
and ( si.id_name like concat('%', #{studentMatchDTO.idNameQuery}, '%') or exists ( select 1 from sys_school_family_contact sfc where sfc.parent_user_id = m.user_id and sfc.student_name like concat('%', #{studentMatchDTO.idNameQuery}, '%') ) )
and si.class_section like concat('%', #{studentMatchDTO.classSectionQuery}, '%')
and m.id IS NULL
and m.match_status = #{studentMatchDTO.matchStatus}
order by si.class_section, si.class_num, si.id_name, si.student_profile_number

select si.student_id, si.in_school, si.school_year, si.student_profile_number, si.adid, si.class_section, si.class_num, si.id_name, si.dsej_student_id from ${studentProfilesDatabase}.student_info si where si.student_id is not null order by si.class_section, si.class_num, si.id_name, si.student_profile_number
mapper.insert: insert into sys_student_match ( student_id, user_id, match_status, create_time ) values ( #{studentId}, #{userId}, #{matchStatus}, sysdate() ) on duplicate key update student_id = values(student_id), user_id = values(user_id), match_status = values(match_status), update_time = sysdate()
mapper.select:
where si.student_id IS NOT NULL and m.id IS NULL
and si.id_name like concat('%', #{studentMatchDTO.idNameQuery}, '%')
and si.class_section like concat('%', #{studentMatchDTO.classSectionQuery}, '%')
order by si.class_section, si.class_num, si.id_name, si.student_profile_number
SELECT user_id FROM sys_student_match WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
